summary: Frontend-only verification of the Cinema/Commercials refactor: scroll-jacked horizontal rail replaced by poster grid + full-screen modal, with /cinema and /publicites dedicated pages. All items in the review request passed with no critical or minor issues.

commercials_page.note: All items default to [Marque] -> only 1 distinct client, chips hidden as expected

critical_code_review_comments: lockScroll counter in /app/frontend/src/lib/smooth.js correctly uses a counter so nested modals (commercial modal + video player) both increment/decrement without clobbering overflow; verified by opening video-player over commercial-modal and getting overflow='' only after both close.
FilmGrid/AdGrid: card index 'n = films.indexOf(f)' is derived from the ORIGINAL (unfiltered) list — good: data-testid film-card-N is stable across filtering, which keeps automation deterministic.
Chips.jsx: hides when keys.length < 2; good UX — avoids a lone chip. Verified on /publicites with 1 client.
FilmModal keydown listener uses stale onClose captured in effect; since onClose is recreated every parent render, effect dependency [onClose] re-binds correctly. OK.

SeeAll uses onClick={() => window.scrollTo(0,0)} but Link navigates asynchronously; the scrollTo fires before route change — relies on fresh page starting at top anyway. Minor: a useEffect(() => window.scrollTo(0,0), []) at the page level would be more robust, but current flow works.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review items passed. Films grid replaces horizontal rail (no more pinned scroll-jack), /cinema has 3 FR chips (Long métrage/Documentaire/Court métrage) plus Tous, /publicites has no chips (single [Marque] client). Scroll lock counter in lib/smooth.js handles nested modals correctly (video-player over commercial-modal).
